title: From Guidelines to Practice: A New Paradigm for Arabic Language Model Evaluation
findings: All tested models struggled significantly with questions on Islamic studies, exhibiting the highest false rates among all categories. Claude 3.5 Sonnet performed relatively better than other models in this domain but still had a high error rate (41.82% False), while other models had false rates over 80%.
